text:
Sanjay: Heads up — noticed ~40 interviews missing scorecard links after last night's ATS schema migration. candidate payloads showing scorecard_template_id: null. anyone else seeing this?

Emma (People Ops): oh no. thanks for flagging. can you drop a sample candidate/interview id and any webhook logs?

Sanjay: sample interview int_345, candidate 0c9b2a. payload snippet: ```json {"candidate_id":"0c9b2a","interview_id":"int_345","scorecard_template_id":null} ``` webhook responded 200 but body missing template field.

ATS Bot: webhook delivered event=interview.created id=int_345 status=200

Chris - Eng: likely the template key rename we rolled last night. we migrated column template_id -> template_key for new rows; there's a compat lambda that should map old->new but looks like it errored. i'm on it.

Emma (People Ops): if we need a backfill what do you need from recruiting? list of impacted interviews?

Sanjay: yes — export of interviews where scorecard_template_id is null and created_at between 2024-06-20 and 2024-06-21. i can run export if you provide the query.

Chris - Eng: use this read-only query on reporting: ```sql SELECT id, interview_id, candidate_id, created_at FROM interviews WHERE scorecard_template_id IS NULL AND created_at BETWEEN '2024-06-20' AND '2024-06-21' LIMIT 10000; ``` run under reporting account.

Sanjay: running now... got 41 rows. uploading CSV to #people-ops-digest.

Maria - Recruiting Ops: thanks — for a quick mitigation can we set a default template to `standard-interviewer` for these? prefer to avoid emailing interviewers/candidates while we fix.

Chris - Eng: yes we can patch. i prepared a script: ```python patch.py --file missing_interviews.csv --set-template standard-interviewer ``` will run in staging first, then prod once Emma signs off.

Emma (People Ops): ok please run staging and paste a sample before prod. i want to verify no side-effects.

Chris - Eng: staging run done. sample int_345 now has +scorecard_template_id=std-101. diff: applied for 3 sample rows. prepping prod run at 15:30 PT. i'll post logs and job id.

Sanjay: awesome, thanks. follow-up ask — can we add an alert when the mapping lambda fails? we lost visibility because webhook returned 200 but mapping error swallowed.

Chris - Eng: good call. i'll add an SLO alert on mapping failures and raise a ticket INF-4876.

Emma (People Ops): also adding a short FAQ for recruiters/interviewers about "missing scorecard link" with the quick workaround and expected timing. posting to onboarding docs.

ATS Bot: deploy job redwood-templates-mapper v2.4 -> prod succeeded (2024-06-21T15:34:12Z)

Chris - Eng: prod job finished, no failures in post-run verification. patched 41 interviews. leaving INF-4876 with follow-ups for a stronger integration test.

Sanjay: thanks everyone. closing loop — i'll monitor any candidate emails and escalate if anything pops up.
